diagnostics.summary: [rds_instance_kms_key_configured] RDS instances must name a customer managed KMS key.
diagnostics.detail:
No change planned: this violation warns until the resource changes; any change to it is blocked.
Fix: Set kms_key_id.
Docs: https://compliance.tf/docs/controls/aws/rds_instance_kms_key_configured/
